script.problem: A quote isn't the BSB's exact words.

terra.problem: Saying the land was already handed over goes beyond God saying He has given it to the Israelites.
The passage does not say nobody will meet Moses on the mountain. It also does not say seeing the land is his whole assignment.
Saying Moses' part ends when he sees the land goes beyond the text. The passage also has him commission Joshua.
The claim that Moses and Aaron went through a lot together draws on events outside the passage without a reference.
The claims about Korah being named earlier in Numbers and not being Moses' brother need references outside this passage.
“Same long road” refers to Moses and Aaron's shared history outside the passage without a reference.
The passage records Moses' request but does not say the people were his first thought.
The passage does not say that sheep without someone out front just wander, or that Moses knows this.
The claim that Israel had fighting ahead draws on events outside the passage without a reference.
The claim that Israel is on a journey draws on context outside the passage without a reference.
The passage does not place Joshua or everyone else in a camp. That detail needs an outside reference.
The claim that Joshua is going to lead an army needs a reference outside the passage.
“Moses uses his hands, and that's all” overlooks the other instructions, including commissioning Joshua.
The text says Joshua is to stand before Eleazar and the congregation; it does not say they are standing.
The text says authority is to be given so the congregation will obey Joshua, not so they will know to follow him.
Saying Joshua will not be guessing his way through adds a claim about his future conduct that the passage does not make.
“No stalling” and “got right to it” add timing the passage does not give.
“No dragging his feet” adds timing the passage does not give.
